would prefer if this was split into multiple patches since there's a lot of code.

For example
- typo fix
- feature patch
- tests

It would help to make it easier for review.
lgtm thanks for the patch

Lets follow out on the typo fix in that thread.

We generally do not split feature patch from unit tests, as it's clear from the commit that the code is in fact tested.  Feel free to segment your review to ignore _test.cpp files if you think the patch is too large and you don't want to review the unit tests, but I'd like them to stay together.

> We generally do not split feature patch from unit tests

I did that a bunch of times in various repos to make patches smaller
and get things merged faster. Did not have many issues with it.

Anyways, i guess the preference for the tests to stay in this patch is valid, it will just take longer for anyone to look into things.

That's great you got patches merged, but I can't point to a single persons patches and apply that to everyone.

> it will just take longer for anyone to look into things.

FWIW, this generally isn't my experience.  Reviewing code that has unit tests is generally a lot easier because the interfaces have been massaged such that they can be tested as a unit, which generally makes code review faster.

To each their own though.
